**RHP** (Region Hovedstadens Psykiatri) is the psychiatric organization operating under [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] [^src1]. This page specifically refers to Region Hovedstadens Psykiatri and should not be confused with other psychiatric units or former names. 

RHP is notable in the context of the [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-DATABASEN]] for its struggles with meeting quality indicator standards and its subsequent improvement initiatives [^src1]. According to the 2023 annual report, RHP did not meet the standards for the database's indicators [^src1]. By the 2024 reporting period, while RHP still failed to meet development goals for several indicators, it performed above or equal to the national average for most of them [^src2]. 

The organization has faced specific challenges regarding registration practices [^src2]. To address these issues, RHP has implemented several improvement initiatives, including exploring the use of other professional groups for registration, introducing automatic registration (such as automatic code drops in the Sundheds Platformen health record system), and increasing focus on educating staff about correct registration practices [^src2]. Additionally, RHP noted that its adult psychiatry department has been particularly affected because the database is relatively new and workflows have not yet been fully implemented [^src2]. 

RHP participated in the formal consultation process for the ADHD-DATABASEN annual report, which took place from December 4, 2024, to January 17, 2025 [^src2].

## Mentions
- Page 46: "Årsrapporten afspejler, at Region Hovedstadens Psykiatri (RHP) ikke opfylder standarderne for indikatorerne i databasen" [^src1]
- Page 66: "Overordnet for RHP opfyldes udviklingsmålet ikke for flere indikatorer i databasen, men regionen ligger over eller svarende til landsgennemsnittet for de fleste indikatorer. Samlet ses der for flere indikatorer udfordringer ift. registreringsparksis. Der arbejdes i RHP med bedring af registrering ved bl.a. at afdække brug af andre faggrupper til registrering, indførsel af automatisk registrering (automatisk kodedrop i Sundheds Platformen) samt fokus på øget information om korrekt registreringspraksis. Voksenpsykiatrien er præget af at databasen er ny og arbejdsgangene ikke er fuldt implementeret endnu." [^src2]
